today.title: Aries horoscope for October 2, 2026

passages.text: Today, clarify the message, route, or conversation closest to hand. For Aries, a clean first move matters more than a dramatic sprint. The last quarter Moon puts messages, errands, siblings, and your local community on the day’s agenda.
List what is shared, what is owed, and what must remain private before making the next commitment. In this reading, Mercury in Scorpio brings attention to shared finances, debts, intimacy, and trust.

After separating the obligations, decide which commitment is actually yours to make. Mercury square Pluto connects shared finances, debts, intimacy, and trust with friends, groups, and plans for the future.
